text:
Priya Rao: Heads-up—planning the user_profiles schema migration that adds `last_seen_at` and moves preferences JSON -> typed columns. Needs a dual-write window + backfill. Proposing Tue Mar 24 02:00 UTC (low traffic). Who can own the deploy and the backfill?

Sam Chen: I can own the deploy and smoke checks.

Miguel Torres: I can run the backfill. Estimate ~40–60m for the backfill on prod given current row counts. I'll run in chunks.

Liz K.: +1 for Tue 02:00 UTC. What's the dual-write window length and rollback plan?

Priya Rao: planning details: dual-write for 15m to be safe (write to old prefs JSON and new typed columns). Backfill will run after dual-write completes. If backfill is slower we can extend but aim to finish without blocking. Rollback: revert to old schema read/writes only by toggling feature flag and rolling back app deploy; DB migration is transactional (we only add columns and backfill), so rollback mainly about stopping writes to new columns and dropping backfill job.

Sam Chen: Smoke checks I'll run (health, heap, request latency). Can we list the exact verification queries?

Priya Rao: yes — quick smoke queries: 
```
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_profiles WHERE last_seen_at IS NOT NULL LIMIT 1;\nSELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_profiles WHERE preferences IS NULL;\n-- sanity: random user matches
SELECT id, preferences, new_pref_col FROM user_profiles WHERE id IN (<sample ids>);\n```
Also check write path in canary: create test user via staging proxy and assert both columns populated.

Miguel Torres: Backfill plan in brief: chunked by id range, 10k rows/transaction, pause if replication lag > 2s. I'll post the backfill script to the runbook channel before deploy.

deploy-bot: NOTE: cluster-maintenance window 02:00-03:30 UTC reserved. No infra reboots scheduled.

Liz K.: Who has permission to pause the backfill if we see issues?

Miguel Torres: I do. I'll be watching and can pause via job controller: `kubectl scale job/backfill-userprefs --replicas=0`.

Priya Rao: Rollback checklist: 
- Flip feature flag `userprefs_typed` -> off (app reads/writes only old json)
- Stop backfill job if running
- Monitor error budget and SLOs for 30m
- If anything severe, roll app deploy back to previous version

Sam Chen: I'll prepare the smoke script and post it into the thread ~30m before deploy. Will also ping @oncall-sre at start.

oncall-sre: I'll be on pager during the window. Add my checks: replication lag, DB CPU, p95 latency. Alert if replication lag > 3s or CPU > 70% for 5m.

Priya Rao: Thanks. Final timeline: 
- 01:30 UTC: pre-deploy checklist, run smoke script against staging
- 02:00 UTC: deploy app change that enables dual-write
- 02:00-02:15 UTC: dual-write window (monitor)
- 02:20 UTC: start backfill (Miguel)
- 02:20-03:20 UTC: backfill running, smoke checks every 15m
- 03:30 UTC: final verification + flag turn-on for full reads from typed columns (if all good)

Sam Chen: Ack. I'll be on the call and posting status updates: `deploy: started`, `deploy: dual-write ok`, `backfill: started`, `backfill: N% done`, `deploy: promote to prod reads` etc.

Miguel Torres: Will post progress like `backfill: 0/4M`, `backfill: 1M/4M (25%)` every 10–15m.

Liz K.: I'll watch product metrics and raise any UX regressions.

Priya Rao: OK locked in. If nothing else—see you Tue 02:00 UTC. Leave any last-minute concerns here. :thumbsup:
